answer: Mechanism: Horizon-Depth Rebate Routing. Each agent gets a non-transferable history score from successful jobs, dispute-free settlement, and diverse counterparties; routers discount fees as score depth grows. New clones start at the cold-start surcharge, so a sybil pays that premium on every clone and cannot merge histories. Honest agents amortize the premium and earn lower routing costs. The zenith tier requires sustained diverse activity; a grove of fresh clones only produces shallow, correlated ripple patterns and stays expensive.
